title: Google Ads Campaigns on Foreign Markets - Dall

facts.fact: Since 2020, Google adds a digital-tax fee to the advertising budget for companies operating in the UK, Austria, and Turkey, according to the vendor article.
facts.quote: since 2020, due to the digital tax, Google adds an additional fee to the advertising budget. This applies to companies operating in the UK, Austria, and Turkey

facts.fact: Per the article, advertising costs in the UK, Austria, and Turkey may be 2-5% higher, depending on the market, because of Google's digital-tax fee.
facts.quote: advertising costs may be 2-5% higher depending on the market.

facts.fact: The article states that CPC and CPM rates can vary significantly depending on the country, without giving specific figures.
facts.quote: CPC/CPM rates can vary significantly depending on the country.

facts.fact: The article says that in Russia and China users prefer local search engines Yandex and Baidu, and in the Czech Republic Seznam is still popular.
